source.sourceTileHashVerification: 100/100 manifest SHA-256 and byte sizes matched before bake
source.method: Each cell aggregates a 10×10 block of z14 raster pixels; DEM10B values are interpolated from Fundamental Geospatial Data elevation data.

print.scaleCorrection: EPSG:3857 projected coordinates multiplied by cos(center latitude) to retain local ground scale.

contours.algorithm: marching squares with bilinear center-value saddle decider; paths stitched on shared interpolated cell edges

counts.validPixels: positive pixel count with finite mean only; null/zero valid_pixels remain nodata
